retention.clear: An exact opaque session can be deleted immediately; a controller reset or process shutdown clears every session and returns no conversation content.
retention.restart: A new process creates an empty store; no prompt, answer, evidence, citation identity, resolved entity or session handle survives.
retention.optional_persistence: not implemented; any future local persistence requires a separately reviewed, explicit user control and its own retention/deletion contract

completed_stream.request_content: dropped as soon as an active request completes or a queued request is cancelled
completed_stream.events: consumed by poll and bounded to eight while pending
completed_stream.source_handles: opaque, in-memory only and removed with their completed request record

diagnostics: Only safe state classes and booleans are exposed. Prompts, answers, evidence, excerpts, paths, artifact content and untrusted worker reason text are not retained in the diagnostic shape.
